Twitch confirms Amazon using user data for AI training, users can opt-out

Twitch has confirmed that Amazon will use user data from livestreams to train artificial intelligence models. This confirmation has led to user backlash, with reports indicating that users might not have opted into this data usage. Twitch has provided a method for users to opt-out of this data collection for AI training purposes.
